scope: Arithmetic analysis of saved results; no new training, inference, threshold tuning or causal ablation

ratio_case.selection_reason: Second-largest positive-fraction error increase among10internalcases with detector20261117/CNN20261114; illustrates nearly cancelling count errors, not a representative mean

selection_policy: validation case-macro localization F1; ties recall,earlier epoch,higher threshold,larger distance
supported_findings: Far fewer unmatched predictions but also fewer matched reference centers: precision rises, recall falls, localization F1 rises.
Positive fraction depends on the balance of predicted positive/negative tumor counts, not just detection F1.
The example's old counts were both grossly inflated with nearly correct fraction; new counts are closer in total but their class balance is further from reference.
Fixed classifier weights are applied to newly detected positions, so classifier inputs and predictions can change.
not_established: Relative contribution of below-threshold map scores, absent local peaks, distance suppression or offsets beyond6px to the extra FN.
Stain, morphology, small model capacity, short training or data support as the dominant causal explanation.
Whether changing a single threshold would restore recall while preserving other metrics.
